title: Swallowed Watermelon Seeds? The 5-Second Belly Truth!

lines.text: Wait! Swallowed Watermelon Seeds? The 5-Second Belly Truth!
Most kids guess totally wrong about swallowing watermelon seeds!
lines.caps: Most kids *GUESS | *TOTALLY wrong about | *SWALLOWING watermelon seeds!

lines.text: Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Stomach gastric acid breaks down food.
while seed shells pass safely through digestion.
seeds need soil, water, and sunlight.
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
lines.caps: Even many *GROWN-UPS | still *BELIEVE the | old rumor *INSTEAD | of *THIS fact!
